checkpoints.name: unused_debug_signal
checkpoints.description: The linter flags `debug_count` — a register that is declared but never driven or read. A classic dead-signal finding: harmless to simulation, but noise that hides real issues.

checkpoints.name: unused_almost_flag
checkpoints.description: `almost` is computed but never used. Same rule as debug_count — students learn a single rule can fire on several signals.

checkpoints.name: width_mismatch
checkpoints.description: A width mismatch: a 4-bit value compared against a 3-bit constant. This is the kind of finding that IS a latent bug, and the triage lesson is telling it apart from the cosmetic unused-signal warnings.

checkpoints.name: at_least_two_unused
checkpoints.description: The by-rule breakdown shows UNUSEDSIGNAL firing at least twice. Reading and counting the by-rule view is the core triage skill.
